title: Services rose from 20% to 48% of Singapore's exports as goods sectors lost share
subtitle: Singapore's exports of goods and services by sector, % of total, 2004, 2014 and 2024
source: Source: team calculation from CEPII BACI (HS 1992, V202601) for goods and World Bank WDI balance-of-payments services exports (BX.GSR.NFSV.CD with category shares BX.GSR.TRAN/TRVL/INSF/CMCP.ZS) for services; RCA computed by the team. BACI downloaded Nov 12, 2026; grouping of HS chapters in the appendix. BACI reconciles exporter and importer reports, so its goods exports for Singapore ($332bn in 2024) are below Singapore's own report to UN Comtrade ($505bn in 2024).
